main.description: While an account's move here is pending (importAccount), bring one of its spaces, as its own server serves it: `meta`, a space it governs (com.atproto.space.exportSpaceMeta's archive), before any repo in it; `repo`, its own repo in a space it wrote in (com.atproto.space.getRepo's archive); or `blob`, one of its files in a space, before the repos that hold it. Only for whoever started the move, and only the account's own. A personalspace or memberspace policy is kept as this host's grants; one this host would not keep as it says is refused.

space.description: The space a meta archive or repo was for.

records.description: How many of a repo's records were kept: one this host would not keep, not of its collection's type, is left out.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No move of the account here by the caller, or a repo in a space of the account's whose meta has not come.

errors.name: NotSpaceOwner
errors.description: A space or repo that is not the account's.

errors.name: InvalidArchive
errors.description: An archive that is not whole, or not what its commit says.

errors.name: UnsupportedPolicy
errors.description: A space whose policy this host would not keep as it says: anyone writing, only some apps, or a managing app.

errors.name: SpaceReserved
errors.description: A space the group makes for itself as it is made.

errors.name: TooLarge
errors.description: More than this host takes in one part.
